snippet.title: AVENGERS DOOMSDAY FINAL TRAILER Doctor Doom, X-Men & Every Hidden Detail!
snippet.description:
Avengers Doomsday Final Trailer, New Footage. To Me, My X-Men! Why Doctor Doom hates Steve Rogers & his Son. X-Men, New Avengers, Thor & Loki and all the new hidden details ► https://bit.ly/AwesomeSubscribe
Avengers Doomsday Scarlet Witch Scene https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=6ejAqUjSkHI&list=PLOIeYdZ3QczwWT3yd94Xc6n-ooI85uV_u&index=1&pp=iAQBsAgCmAkA

New DCU Batman https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=FMdL1T4k_Is&list=PLOIeYdZ3QczwCLH9RIm-7ui56ameRYmdQ&index=1&pp=iAQBsAgC
Emergency Awesome New Videos https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=FeOfhzu7ZdY&list=PLOIeYdZ3QczxQXxyV_2D8kuEs_QsuQIyJ&index=7

Covering new Final Avengers Doomsday Trailer. Why Doctor Doom hates Steve Rogers and his son James Rogers and blames them for the death of his own family. What Happens to Steve Rogers Son James Rogers. Multiverse Avengers Assemble new footage and fight scenes.

Why Some Marvel characters are Helping Doctor Doom. And why he needs their power. New Avengers Doomsday Promos and Trailer Footage. Another new version of Doctor Doom. What Marvel plans on doing with Doctor Doom after Avengers Secret Wars during Marvel Phase 7 when they begin focusing on X-Men Movies and other Mutant based movies.

First Look at Latveria, new battle Doctor Doom vs Everyone. Why the X-Men team up with the Fantastic Four and Avengers. The Fantastic Four explain incursions to Channing Tatum's Gambit. 

Why marvel reveals Scarlet Witch and Doctor Strange are so important. Robert Downey Jr and Pedro Pascal Doctor Doom Reed Richards video, More Captain America Jokes, and Thor takes Steve Rogers to Meet God Loki at the TVA. The Fantastic Four play baseball in the 828 Universe as an incursion happens. Doctor Doom Timeline, New Thor and Captain America Scene, Steve Rogers asks Thor about his Hammer. Ant-Man gets confused about Steve Rogers Captain America and Sam Wilson.

Why Doctor Doom is collecting powerful Marvel Characters and Items. Doctor Doom vs Thanos, Silver Surfer, Venom Symbiote, Ultimate Nullifier and other major references.

Marvel Zodiac Trailer Easter Eggs. How the ending of Spider-Man Brand New Day sets up Sadie Sink's Jean Grey for all her future X-Men Movies. The Hulk Ending, and why Hulk also skips Avengers Doomsday, but returns during Avengers Secret Wars. Spider-Man vs Sadie Sink. Jean Grey New Powers Explained. New Spider-Man AI and Suit Tech Explained. Spider-Man vs Damage Control, X-Men Jean Grey, Bruce Banner Savage Hulk, Sadie Sink New Character, Spider-Man vs Punisher. Tom Holland and Jon Bernthal reunion. New Spider-Man Suit First Look. Hulk Announcement. Why Bruce Banner would help Spider-Man, Spider-Man vs Hulk, Spider-Man Movies previous references to The Hulk. The Scorpion Returns, Tombstone, Jackal and other new villains. Miles Morales Spider-Man Easter Eggs

Spider-Man vs Sadie Sink Jean Grey, Jean Grey Phoenix Powers. Spider-Man Brand New Day Post Credit Scene & Avengers Doomsday Trailer Connection. Robert Downey Jr Doctor Doom, New Black Panther, X-Men, Doctor Strange. Why Marvel is rebooting the MCU with Avengers 6 Secret Wars. What's going to change with all the Avengers, New Iron Man, X-Men Mutants like Wolverine, Deadpool, Fantastic Four, Ghost Rider, Spider-Man and other characters. 

Lots more Marvel Trailers coming Avengers Doomsday Trailers, Avengers Secret Wars Teasers, and X-Men 2028 videos!

snippet.title: That Epic Team Up Is NOT The Final Battle! AVENGERS DOOMSDAY FINAL TRAILER REACTION
snippet.description:
TO ME, MY X-MEN!!  Avengers Doomsday Final Trailer Reaction - With hype through the roof, Coy & John REACT to Avengers: Doomsday Final Trailer from Marvel Studios!!
👕 Doctor Doom rides a sandworm! Grab EMPEROR DUNE, our new Avengers × Dune mashup tee 👉 https://shorturl.at/2Modm

Doctor Doom, Steve Rogers, the X-Men & Fantastic Four finally collide as we react to Marvel Studios’ Avengers: Doomsday Final Trailer, featuring Chris Evans returning as Steve Rogers, now living happily alongside Peggy Carter (Hayley Atwell) and their young son - that is, until the Fantastic 4 show up in search of Steve's help...

The trailer also features new looks at Robert Downey Jr.’s Doctor Doom, James Marsden’s Cyclops taking the lead & finally speaking the iconic line, “To me, my X-Men,” the Sentinels, Steve and Thor’s Mjolnir banter, and heroes from three universes joining forces. With Avengers: Secret Wars ahead, we discuss Doom’s warning about their “stolen lives,” the consequences of Avengers: Endgame, the coming multiverse incursion, and beyond!

Watch The Official Final Trailer: https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=Wb8Tq_HD4E8

#AvengersDoomsday #AvengersDoomsdayTrailer #DoctorDoom #RobertDowneyJr #ChrisEvans #CaptainAmerica #Cyclops #XMen #FantasticFour #Avengers #Marvel #MCU #TrailerReaction #ReelRejects #AvengersSecretWars

Directed by Anthony and Joe Russo (Avengers: Infinity War, Avengers: Endgame) and written by Stephen McFeely, Avengers: Doomsday stars Robert Downey Jr. as Victor von Doom/Doctor Doom (Iron Man, Oppenheimer), Chris Evans as Steve Rogers/Captain America (The Winter Soldier, Knives Out), Hayley Atwell as Peggy Carter (Agent Carter, Mission: Impossible – Dead Reckoning), Chris Hemsworth as Thor (Thor: Ragnarok, Extraction), Pedro Pascal as Reed Richards/Mister Fantastic (The Last of Us, The Mandalorian), Vanessa Kirby as Sue Storm/Invisible Woman (Mission: Impossible – Fallout, Napoleon), and James Marsden as Scott Summers/Cyclops (X-Men, Sonic the Hedgehog).

Avengers: Doomsday arrives exclusively in theaters December 18, 2026!

Our Avengers: Doomsday FINAL TRAILER REACTION is here! Marvel Studios just dropped the final trailer, and we’re jumping straight into the new footage, returning characters and everything it sets up before the movie arrives. There is a LOT to talk about with this one.

Robert Downey Jr.’s Doctor Doom, Chris Evans’ Steve Rogers, Chris Hemsworth’s Thor, the Fantastic Four and the X-Men...where do we even start? Directed by Anthony and Joe Russo, Avengers: Doomsday (2026) brings these worlds together, and we’re sharing our reaction and discussing what this final trailer could mean for the story.

What was THE moment for you in this trailer? Drop your favorite reveal and your Doctor Doom theories in the comments! If you enjoy watching and talking movies with us, leave a like and subscribe to The Media Knights for more Marvel reactions, movie reactions and discussions.

snippet.title: AVENGERS: DOOMSDAY Final Trailer Reaction - Cyclops Gets His Moment!
snippet.description:
The Avengers, Fantastic Four, and X-Men are assembling for the end of everything.

Hector and Adam react to the final trailer for Marvel Studios’ Avengers: Doomsday! The new footage reveals Steve Rogers and Peggy Carter’s son, brings the Fantastic Four into Steve’s timeline, and gives us our biggest look yet at Doctor Doom’s multiversal war.

We break down Cyclops finally declaring, “To me, my X-Men,” the return of Marvel’s original mutant team, the alliance between the Avengers and New Avengers, and the massive battle against Doom and his Sentinels. Can Earth’s Mightiest Heroes survive when entire universes begin colliding?

In our discussion, we debate whether making Doctor Doom a variant of Tony Stark was the right creative choice and how that decision could affect the Marvel Cinematic Universe moving forward. We also explain why Doom should be more than a one-time Avengers villain, how he could remain a major presence throughout the MCU, and how Doomsday may set the stage for Secret Wars and the eventual merging of multiple universes into one.

Avengers: Doomsday arrives exclusively in theaters December 18, 2026.

snippet.title: AVENGERS: DOOMSDAY FINAL TRAILER REACTION! (I CRIED OMG)
snippet.description:
AVENGERS: DOOMSDAY (2026) FINAL TRAILER REACTION! Zach Pope Reviews reacts to Chris Evans returning as Steve Rogers, his emotional moments with his son, Robert Downey Jr. as Doctor Doom, and Marvel Studios bringing together the Avengers, Fantastic Four, and X-Men!

THIS AVENGERS: DOOMSDAY TRAILER MADE ME EMOTIONAL AS A FATHER.

I was expecting INSANE action, Doctor Doom, massive crossovers, and some incredible Marvel moments.

BUT STEVE ROGERS AND HIS SON?!

THAT'S WHAT GOT ME.

We've watched Steve Rogers sacrifice so much throughout the Marvel Cinematic Universe. He was always willing to put the world before himself. And at the end of AVENGERS: ENDGAME, he finally got his chance to live the life he deserved with Peggy Carter.

Now we're seeing him as a FATHER.

And as a dad myself, there's something about that which hit me harder than I expected.

Steve Rogers isn't just fighting for the world anymore. He's a man with a family, a son, and something deeply personal to protect. Seeing that side of a character I've followed for so many years reminded me why these Marvel movies can be so powerful.

THE EMOTIONAL STAKES MATTER!

IN MY AVENGERS: DOOMSDAY FINAL TRAILER REACTION:
• Why Steve Rogers and his son made me emotional as a father
• Chris Evans returning as Captain America / Steve Rogers
• Steve and Peggy Carter's life after Avengers: Endgame
• How becoming a parent changes the meaning of heroism and sacrifice
• Robert Downey Jr. returning to Marvel as Doctor Doom
• The enormous stakes of the multiverse collapsing
• The Avengers, New Avengers, Fantastic Four, and X-Men
• James Marsden returning as Cyclops and the epic X-Men moments
• The Russo brothers returning after Infinity War and Endgame
• Why character-driven storytelling is just as important as the biggest action scenes
• Whether Avengers: Doomsday can deliver another unforgettable cinematic event

AND DON'T GET ME WRONG...

THE REST OF THIS TRAILER IS ABSOLUTELY MASSIVE!

ROBERT DOWNEY JR. AS DOCTOR DOOM!
THE FANTASTIC FOUR!
THE ORIGINAL X-MEN!
THE AVENGERS COMING TOGETHER!

I am SO excited for the spectacle and the incredible character interactions. But the thing that makes me believe this movie could be something special is how personal the story feels.

We've spent years growing alongside these heroes. Now we're seeing them face questions about family, legacy, love, and what they're willing to sacrifice to protect the people who matter most.

That's what I need from DOOMSDAY.

Not just insane cameos and action.

HEART. CONSEQUENCES. REAL EMOTION.

Directed by Joe and Anthony Russo, AVENGERS: DOOMSDAY arrives exclusively in theaters DECEMBER 18, 2026.

OFFICIAL MOVIE PAGE:
https://movies.disney.com/avengers-doomsday

LET'S DISCUSS:
Did Steve Rogers and his son make YOU emotional?
How do you feel about Steve becoming a father?
What's your favorite moment from the final trailer?
Are you most excited for Doctor Doom, the Avengers, Fantastic Four, or X-Men?
Can Doomsday match the emotional impact of Infinity War and Endgame?

I love how this trailer gave us SO much Steve Rogers (or is it Loki?) so Much Cyclops, a dash more DOOM and of course plenty of glorious action. First a reaction, then a full frame by frame breakdown of the trailer!



What did YOU think of this long awaited Doomsday Trailer?

Avengers: Doomsday is an upcoming American superhero film based on the Marvel Comics superhero team the Avengers. Produced by Marvel Studios and distributed by Walt Disney Studios Motion Pictures, it is intended to be the sequel to Avengers: Endgame (2019) and the 39th film in the Marvel Cinematic Universe (MCU). Directed by Anthony and Joe Russo, and written by Michael Waldron, Stephen McFeely, and the writing team of Chris McKenna and Erik Sommers, the film features an ensemble cast led by Robert Downey Jr. as Doctor Doom. In the film, the Avengers, Wakandans, New Avengers, Fantastic Four, and the X-Men converge from different universes to face Doom.

Two new Avengers films, The Kang Dynasty and Secret Wars, were announced in July 2022 as the conclusion of the MCU's Phase Six and "The Multiverse Saga". Jonathan Majors was set to reprise his MCU role as the villain Kang the Conqueror, with Destin Daniel Cretton and Jeff Loveness hired to direct and write The Kang Dynasty, respectively. In November 2023, Cretton departed, Waldron replaced Loveness as writer, and Marvel was considering moving away from the Kang storyline, in part due to Majors's legal issues; Majors was fired the following month. The return of the Russo brothers as directors and McFeely as co-writer, the casting of Downey as new villain Doctor Doom, and the new subtitle Doomsday were all announced in July 2024. The large cast features actors from previous MCU media and 20th Century Fox's X-Men film series, using the idea of colliding universes to bring together actors from different franchises. Filming took place from April to September 2025 at Pinewood Studios in England, with location filming in England and Bahrain.

Avengers: Doomsday is scheduled to be released in the United States on December 18, 2026, as part of Phase Six of the MCU. The sequel, Avengers: Secret Wars, is set to be released on December 17, 2027.

snippet.description:
IT'S TIME AND THIS TIME IT'S FOR REAL

#MCU #Marvel #MarvelCinematicUniverse

Marvel fans, Kevin Feige and Marvel Studios revealed A LOT at D23 Brazil over the weekend... In this video, we're breaking EVERYTHING down! This includes some stuff Kevin Feige said that very few are talking about!

Marvel fans, we just got a few reports about Doctor Strange 3 and Blade that change EVERYTHING we thought we knew about the end of the Multiverse Saga! We're breaking down the latest news in this video!

Ever since RDJ got on stage at Comic-Con to reveal he was playing Doctor Doom, fans have wondered WHY... WE NOW HAVE THE ANSWER!!! This video explains all the evidence that is pointing to a MASSIVE TWIST about Iron Man being Victor Von Doom in the MCU's past...

Marvel fan, we have some CRAZY new reveals to discuss today!! We have production updates about Avengers Doomsday and Avengers Secret Wars! We have details about Spider-Man 4 that are interesting AND NEW DETAILS about the Battleworld Movies including Doctor Strange 3 and a SECRET MCU movie that comes out BEFORE Doomsday! Kevin Feige is cooking, and we want to update you about it all!!!

We've got new details about Kevin Feige's plan for RDJ Doctor Doom! This has to do with Avengers Doomsday, Victor and Reed Richards, AND Doctor Doom after Secret Wars!

Marvel fans, we have A TON of new MCU updates and leaks to talk about! There are updates around Doctor Strange 3, a Wanda Scarlet Witch spin off, a Silver Surfer project, AND massive leaks about a scene that sets up RDJ Doctor Doom in the MCU!!!

Marvel fans, we NEED to talk about a new Captain America Brave New World plot leak and how it sets up Kevin Feige's plan for RDJ Doctor Doom! This is really crazy!!! SPOILER WARNING!!!!

Marvel fans, we need to talk about how and insider recently revealed Kevin Feige's plan for Elizabeth Olsen as the Scarlet Witch in the MCU! This is way crazier than I thought it would be! SO MUCH WANDA IS COMING! Could this tie to RDJ Doctor Doom??? I THINK YES!!!

Marvel fans, THIS ONE IS CRAZY! We just got several reports and confirmations from insiders about the changing plot of Tom Holland's Spider-Man 4 and how that will connect to Venom The Last Dance AND KNULL!!! I can't believe they are doing this, and I honestly have some mixed feelings about it...

Marvel fans, we have some MASSIVE news about Tom Holland's Spider-Man 4! We have news of a director AND lots of leakers and insiders have chimed in on what is actually happening behind the scenes. PLUS there's some bad updates about Beyond The Spider-Verse, but I also think I know what's going on there! FULL BREAKDOWN HERE!!!

Marvel fans, we have EVEN MORE set photos from the Fantastic Four! We need to breakdown the potential leak of Frankie Raye Nova as the herald of Galactus AND we need to talk about what is going on in this scene. This was in the old plot leaks and it has to do with Franklin Richards!!!

Marvel fans, we recently got some INSANE reveals about Deadpool and Wolverine AND they are an even bigger deal than most people realize! This has to do with a new Avengers symbol that Ryan Reynolds is teasing AND how it might connect to new rumors about RDJ Iron Man! FULL BREAKDOWN HERE!

Marvel fans, we recently got another trailer for Deadpool and Wolverine and this trailer focused on Logan! However, we've come to realize this Wolverine is NOT WHO YOU THINK! In this video, we break down his true identity AND explain why this is perfect for the MCU!

Marvel fans, we need to talk about Doctor Doom being the villain of Avengers Secret Wars! Some think Kevin Feige is changing the plan to go away from Kang, BUT there's some evidence that Doctor Doom was ALWAYS the planned villain of Avengers Secret Wars! THERE'S ACTUALLY SOME PROOF OF THIS!!

WE JUST GOT ANOTHER X-MEN IN THE MCU! The post-credit scene of The Marvels shows us Beast, BUT it actually shows us much more than most fans think! This scene actually shows us what Kevin Feige's plan for the X-Men in the MCU is! Let's get into this and break it down in FULL DETAIL!

The ending of Loki Season Two was INSANE! But... What actually happened? In this video I'm going to explain what happened, AND I'm going to explain HOW it happened! There are clues in the show, and in other MCU projects, that give us clues to what is really happening for the Loki character. THIS WILL BLOW YOUR MIND!

Marvel fans, we need to talk about new leaked information about the ending of Loki Season 2!! This is really crazy and ties into leaks about Deadpool 3 and Secret Wars in the MCU!! Kevin Feige has some really cool stuff planned for Loki!!!

snippet.title: GTA 6 is Underperforming
snippet.description:
Two things can still be true at once. GTA 6 can be the fastest-selling game ever, be a cultural battleground, and achieve profitability instantly. Yet they may still "underperform" in the eyes of Wall Street investors, who just adjusted their expectations to sell 65 million units by December '26 and 80 million units by March '27. 

The question now becomes, will the cultural backlash to the game stop people who haven't bought it yet from buying? Does it matter? Either way, Take-Two, Sony, and Microsoft made BANK on GTA 6 in the short term. What happens next is up to gamers... GTA 6 clearing 65-80 million copies sold in those time frames signals more corporate investment and control of gaming.

snippet.title: You Are Playing GTA 6 Wrong - How The Criminal Profile System Actually Works
snippet.description:
I explain how the criminal profile system works in GTA 6. This covers how Jason and Lucia move between Professional, Hardened, Violent, Psycho, and Irredeemable.

I go through what raises or lowers your profile, including non-lethal shots, stealth takedowns, clean getaways, killing civilians, killing fleeing enemies, and pointless shootouts. Then I test robberies at Shore Front and a jewelry shop to show why planning with Jason and Lucia, shutting off alarms, using the snap gun after Chapter 3, and leaving before police arrive can matter. I also cover focus refill changes, police behavior, surrender rules, the permanent Irredeemable lock, and how profile status can affect

snippet.title: DETAILED Breakdown of Final Avengers Doomsday Trailer!!
snippet.description:
TIME TO GET DETAILED and break down this new Avengers Doomsday trailer!!! THERE'S A LOT TO BREAK DOWN!!!

Check out the streams here: @TheDenofNerdsLIVE 



#marvel #marvelcinematicuniverse #mcu 


This actually surprised me... Avengers Endgame Encore seems LEGIT!!!

Marvel fans, Kevin Feige and Marvel Studios revealed A LOT at D23 Brazil over the weekend... In this video, we're breaking EVERYTHING down! This includes some stuff Kevin Feige said that very few are talking about!

Marvel fans, we just got a few reports about Doctor Strange 3 and Blade that change EVERYTHING we thought we knew about the end of the Multiverse Saga! We're breaking down the latest news in this video!

Ever since RDJ got on stage at Comic-Con to reveal he was playing Doctor Doom, fans have wondered WHY... WE NOW HAVE THE ANSWER!!! This video explains all the evidence that is pointing to a MASSIVE TWIST about Iron Man being Victor Von Doom in the MCU's past...

Marvel fan, we have some CRAZY new reveals to discuss today!! We have production updates about Avengers Doomsday and Avengers Secret Wars! We have details about Spider-Man 4 that are interesting AND NEW DETAILS about the Battleworld Movies including Doctor Strange 3 and a SECRET MCU movie that comes out BEFORE Doomsday! Kevin Feige is cooking, and we want to update you about it all!!!

We've got new details about Kevin Feige's plan for RDJ Doctor Doom! This has to do with Avengers Doomsday, Victor and Reed Richards, AND Doctor Doom after Secret Wars!

Marvel fans, we have A TON of new MCU updates and leaks to talk about! There are updates around Doctor Strange 3, a Wanda Scarlet Witch spin off, a Silver Surfer project, AND massive leaks about a scene that sets up RDJ Doctor Doom in the MCU!!!

Marvel fans, we NEED to talk about a new Captain America Brave New World plot leak and how it sets up Kevin Feige's plan for RDJ Doctor Doom! This is really crazy!!! SPOILER WARNING!!!!

Marvel fans, we need to talk about how and insider recently revealed Kevin Feige's plan for Elizabeth Olsen as the Scarlet Witch in the MCU! This is way crazier than I thought it would be! SO MUCH WANDA IS COMING! Could this tie to RDJ Doctor Doom??? I THINK YES!!!

Marvel fans, THIS ONE IS CRAZY! We just got several reports and confirmations from insiders about the changing plot of Tom Holland's Spider-Man 4 and how that will connect to Venom The Last Dance AND KNULL!!! I can't believe they are doing this, and I honestly have some mixed feelings about it...

Marvel fans, we have some MASSIVE news about Tom Holland's Spider-Man 4! We have news of a director AND lots of leakers and insiders have chimed in on what is actually happening behind the scenes. PLUS there's some bad updates about Beyond The Spider-Verse, but I also think I know what's going on there! FULL BREAKDOWN HERE!!!

Marvel fans, we have EVEN MORE set photos from the Fantastic Four! We need to breakdown the potential leak of Frankie Raye Nova as the herald of Galactus AND we need to talk about what is going on in this scene. This was in the old plot leaks and it has to do with Franklin Richards!!!

Marvel fans, we recently got some INSANE reveals about Deadpool and Wolverine AND they are an even bigger deal than most people realize! This has to do with a new Avengers symbol that Ryan Reynolds is teasing AND how it might connect to new rumors about RDJ Iron Man! FULL BREAKDOWN HERE!

snippet.title: wait, that was kinda good?!
snippet.description:
🎬 In this FilmSpeak video essay, we discuss the final Avengers Doomsday trailer and how it was kinda good?!
🔔 SUBSCRIBE: https://youtube.com/filmspeak?sub_confirmation=1

The final Avengers: Doomsday trailer is here and… honestly? That was kinda good?! With Chris Evans returning as Steve Rogers, Marvel finally gives us a clearer sense of what its next Avengers movie could actually be about. Beneath the reunions, Doctor Doom, and the return of the original X-Men cast, there’s the possibility of a story about imperfect heroes, the burden of their legacy, and the dangers of returning to a world you’ve outgrown.

In this Avengers: Doomsday trailer breakdown and reaction, FilmSpeak examines Steve Rogers’ return, his relationship with his son, and why reuniting him with Thor could give the film some much-needed emotional weight. From the Fantastic Four and Doom to Sam Wilson’s Captain America and the Thunderbolts’ New Avengers, these characters could bring Marvel’s post-Endgame identity crisis into focus. Could bringing back the legacy cast help the MCU confront its obsession with recreating its past?

But there’s still plenty giving me pause, especially Doom’s characterization, Sam’s absence from the spotlight, and the hollow nostalgia of that Cyclops moment. The Russo Brothers have delivered the strongest sales pitch for Avengers: Doomsday yet. The question is whether the movie will actually follow through on the ideas this trailer suggests.

snippet.description:
GTA 6 UNLIMITED MONEY: FASTEST Way To Get Unlimited Money Right Now!
►If you enjoyed the video, please consider hitting 👍 LIKE and ✅ Subscribe for more!
►https://youtu.be/T1vPOG71oHk

The easiest unlimited money glitch in GTA 6 right now. Loot the Apollo Aggregates warehouse, stash the bags in your vehicle, save and reload, and the loot comes straight back. Then sell it all at Brian's Lockup and collect the cash from Jason's mailbox. Fully solo, and you can start it in Chapter 1, but it's far more effective from Chapter 2 onwards. Use it before Rockstar patches it!

💰 HOW THE GTA 6 MONEY GLITCH WORKS

Bring your own vehicle with storage (a pickup truck is perfect).
Go to the Apollo Aggregates warehouse, east of Hamlet in South Vice-Dale County.
Loot the teddy-bear truck outside first, then the cocaine, the safe, the cash bag and the van inside.
Stash the bags in your vehicle.
Save, then load that save. The bags stay in your vehicle and the warehouse restocks.
Repeat, then sell everything at Brian's Lockup in Key Lento (keypad code 7700).
Collect your cash from the mailbox outside Jason's house.
⚠️ IMPORTANT: Cash you're carrying is lost at the end of Chapter 1. Only money in your BuckMe account carries over. That's why this glitch is best from Chapter 2 onwards. If you're still in Chapter 1, bank it all in BuckMe!

snippet.title: 🔴 LIVE 🏈 Washington Commanders vs Cincinnati Bengals / NFL Watch Party / Live Score + Madden 27 Sim!
snippet.description:
Welcome to Week 11 of the 2026 NFL season as the 3-5-1 Washington Commanders host the 7-2 Cincinnati Bengals on Monday Night Football at Northwest Stadium. Washington returns home off a mini-bye following a 24-21 road victory over the New York Giants, looking to build momentum in the NFC East. Cincinnati arrives atop the AFC North on a five-game winning streak after defeating Pittsburgh 38-18 last week, holding an opportunity to strengthen its conference positioning. This interconference pairing matches a Bengals offense ranked first in passing at 310.6 yards per game and third in scoring at 30.9 points per contest against a Commanders defense allowing 260.1 passing yards per game.

The Commanders approach this contest with quarterback Jayden Daniels carrying no injury designation after practicing in full all week while managing a left elbow issue. Daniels will look to distribute the ball to wide receivers Stefon Diggs and Treylon Burks alongside tight end Chig Okonkwo, as Washington continues operating with Terry McLaurin on injured reserve. In the backfield, the rotation remains unsettled with running backs Rachaad White and Jacory Croskey-Merritt both listed as questionable, while center Lucas Patrick is also questionable despite being named the planned starter. Defensively, Washington brings a plus-seven turnover differential and relies on linebacker Sonny Styles—who recorded 13 tackles against the Giants—and safety Quan Martin, while monitoring the status of cornerback Amik Robertson, who enters the night listed as questionable with an ankle injury.

For the Bengals, the offensive structure runs through quarterback Joe Burrow, who practiced in full all week following an illness and enters with no game designation. Burrow will look to target wide receivers Ja'Marr Chase and Tee Higgins—who is also cleared after managing a knee issue—while wide receiver Andrei Iosivas is listed as doubtful with a thumb injury. Cincinnati must adjust its interior protection for running backs Chase Brown and Samaje Perine, as right guard Dalton Risner has been ruled out with a knee injury and guards Dylan Fairchild and Brian Parker II are both questionable. On the defensive side of the ball, the Bengals will operate without linebacker Oren Burks and likely without cornerback Jalen Davis, who is listed as doubtful, while monitoring the availability of safety Kyle Dugger and cornerback Dax Hill as the unit looks to contain Daniels on the road.

snippet.title: What If You Could Breathe Underwater and Your Crush Was the Lifeguard?
snippet.description:
what if you could breathe underwater and your crush was the lifeguard? 🌊🛟 You're 18, it's your first week of college, and the first time you slip into the campus pool you find out you can breathe water just as easily as air. You lie on the bottom, calm and happy. But there's one unexpected twist: the lifeguard on duty is your crush, and she thinks you're drowning.

In this animated what-if scenario, we imagine living with a power nobody believes: every swim becomes a rescue, every rescue becomes a number on her clipboard, and three of them get you banned from the pool. You try waving, you try a stopwatch, you try the campus pond, and she still dives in every single time, with the rescue tube, the whistle and a very worried face. Would you tell her you're fine? Or would you keep being rescued, because every rescue means one more awkward coffee with the one person you could never say hello to?

This funny, awkward adventure explores secrets, crushes, trust and what it takes to be believed, from a lifeguard's chair to a weedy campus pond. And when the day comes that she is the one who goes under, would you finally show her the truth?

If you enjoyed this adventure, watch our other videos:

💘 What If You Switched Genders and Became Your Crush's Best Friend? 🛏️ What If You and Your Crush Got Snowed In With Only ONE BED? 💪 What If Every Push-Up Made You More Attractive? 🔮 What If You Could See Every Girl Who Ever Had a Crush on You? 💸 What If You Got $1 Every Time Someone Talked About You? ⚡ What If You Had Superpowers?

Here's the real question: would you keep "drowning" so she would keep diving in, or would you finally tell her you're fine?

Tell us in the comments, and subscribe to help us reach 2,000 subscribers! Join us for more animated what-if scenarios, impossible adventures, awkward crushes and unexpected love stories!

snippet.title: GTA 6 Is the Most Expensive Flop Ever Made
snippet.description:
GTA 6 took 13 years and cost more than any movie ever made. It sold 3.79 billion dollars in a day, and the players who bought it gave it a 5.2. Here's why GTA 6 is bad, why the 99 review score doesn't match what players and streamers like Asmongold, penguinz0, Nick Eh 30, Jynxzi and Burnt Peanut said in launch week, and why Rockstar doesn't care.

The 90-second version: https://youtube.com/shorts/-ybIK54mv-s

Watch this next: Your First Day in Prison Is a Trap
https://youtu.be/825bNIubsiM

Chapters
0:00 13 years
0:37 The proof
1:48 The story is chores
3:45 The missions keep you on a leash
4:11 When the story ends, so does the game
4:33 They charged you more for it
6:43 Why Rockstar doesn't care

Streamers and creators clipped (a few seconds each, for commentary)
- Nick Eh 30
- Burnt Peanut (via Grummz on X)
- penguinz0, "Does GTA 6 Live Up to the Hype"
- Asmongold (two clips)
- Jynxzi (via bloomjpg on X)

Sources (checked 21 and 22 November 2026)
- Take-Two press release, 20 Nov 2026: $3.79 billion day-one retail sales, 32.5 million sold before launch (company estimates)
- Cost: analysts estimate $1 billion to $1.5 billion (Business Insider, Fortune); Rockstar's Jennifer Kolbe said it did not pass about $1.5 billion (Bloomberg, 14 Oct 2026)
- Metacritic: user score opened at 5.2 (Notebookcheck, 20 Nov); GTA V user score 8.5; Metascore 99
- Reviews quoted: Push Square, The Guardian, Game Informer; ScreenHub via ABC News (19 Nov)
- GTA+ inside story mode, $7.99 a month, no comment from Rockstar: LADbible (19 Nov)
- Take-Two shareholder meeting, 17 Sep 2026: no recurrent spending at launch (GTA Boom)
- 30 fps on every console including PS5 Pro: VGC; no mission replay: X posts by Daily Loud and others
- Boxed copy is a download code: Windows Central
- 78% of Take-Two net bookings from recurrent consumer spending: Take-Two results (GamesBeat, 9 Nov 2026)
- Sam Houser launch statement (18 Nov); the fake apology was debunked by an X community note
- Chapter 1 mission count and heist timing: published mission lists
- X posts shown with their authors' names. Swear words and one offensive passage are blurred.

Gameplay: GTA 6 captured on console. Music: YouTube Audio Library.

#GTA6 #GTAVI #Rockstar
